notes.title: How the cuisine filters were policed
notes.body: Every food card names a specific dish — a cuisine label alone doesn’t qualify. Orlando’s canon starts with what is unique to it: the Mills 50 Vietnamese corridor (pho, banh mi, bun bo hue), Puerto Rican Kissimmee (mofongo, lechón), Cuban sandwiches and café, Florida gator, citrus & key lime, a deep Michelin bench (Sorekara, Kadence, Camille, Soseki, Ômo by Jônt, Victoria & Albert’s) — and the theme-park signature eats as their own layer (Dole Whip, Butterbeer, turkey legs). A cuisine tag names the kitchen’s own tradition, never one dish it happens to serve.

notes.title: Web-searched and fact-checked
notes.body: Every place is traceable to at least two credible sources (or one Michelin/James Beard/NPS listing) — the Orlando Sentinel, Orlando Weekly, Orlando Magazine, Michelin, NASA, Florida State Parks, Atlas Obscura, Wikipedia and vetted theme-park outlets; a park operator’s own page counts once. Recorded in data/sources.json. Every coordinate is verified into data/geocodes.json — attractions are pinned where they stand inside each park, never at a park centroid. Yelp/TripAdvisor never count toward the two-source bar.

places.w: Pioneer of Orlando's craft-cocktail scene (downtown 2012-2022, reopened in Winter Park Oct 2022); reviewed by The Infatuation and Scott Joseph, and on Orlando Weekly's 20 best cocktail bars. Order: Rotating craft cocktail list + smashburger.

places.ad: 523 Virginia Dr, Orlando, FL 32803
places.w: Decades-old Ivanhoe Village dive (Miami Dolphins fan-club home) on Orlando Weekly's essential dive bars lists; moved across Virginia Dr from 516 to 523 as part of The Yard at Ivanhoe; listed by Bungalower. Order: Hot Marino sandwich.

places.ad: 3201 Corrine Dr (East End Market), Orlando, FL 32803
places.w: Small-batch roaster at East End Market on Orlando Weekly's '10 best craft coffee and tea shops' and Tasty Chomps' best local coffee shops guide. Order: Single-origin pour-over.

places.n: Foxtail Coffee Co. (Winter Park Social House)
places.ad: 1282 N Orange Ave, Winter Park, FL 32789
places.w: Won Best Local Coffee Roaster in Orlando Weekly's 2026 Best of Orlando readers' poll; flagship Winter Park roastery, covered by Tasty Chomps and trade outlet Daily Coffee News. Order: Nitro cold brew.

places.ad: 626 N Alafaya Trail Ste 105, Orlando, FL 32828
places.w: Multi-roaster specialty bar near UCF/Waterford Lakes (since 2013) on Orlando Weekly's '10 best craft coffee and tea shops' and Tasty Chomps' best local coffee shops guide. Order: Hario siphon coffee.

places.ad: 47 E Robinson St Unit 100, Orlando, FL 32801
places.w: Downtown espresso bar-plus-home-goods shop in the old Java Lava space, covered by Orlando Weekly and Bungalower and included in Tasty Chomps' best local coffee shops guide. Order: Wild Child Latte (rose-cardamom).

places.ad: 2240 W Fairbanks Ave, Winter Park, FL 32789
places.w: Decades-old Winter Park coffeehouse whose open-mic nights Orlando Weekly readers repeatedly voted best; News 6 reported its 2025 move from 929 W Fairbanks to 2240 W Fairbanks after the city bought the old site. Order: In-house micro-roasted organic coffee.

places.ad: 3213 Curry Ford Rd, Orlando, FL 32806
places.w: Orlando institution since 1971 (WFTV, News 6 on its 50th year under new owner); runner-up Best Bakery in Orlando Weekly's Best of Orlando 2026 readers' poll. Order: Gourmet pastries & cakes.

places.ad: 426 W Plant St (Plant Street Market), Winter Garden, FL 34787
places.w: Anchor of Winter Garden's Plant Street Market since 2014 (Orange Observer, 10th-anniversary coverage 2025); listed by Visit Florida and placed in Scott Joseph's Foodster microbrewery award voting. Order: Flagship craft drafts (Barrel Room specials).

places.ad: 419 S Sanford Ave, Sanford, FL 32771
places.w: Sanford's first microbrewery (2014), in the landmark Stokes Fish Market building; on Tasty Chomps' '10 craft breweries to try in Sanford' (2025) and profiled by the Sanford Herald. Order: House-brewed drafts in the Stokes Fish Market building.

places.ad: 1012 W Church St, Orlando, FL 32805
places.w: Parramore taproom between Camping World and Inter&Co stadiums; WFTV and Orlando Weekly reported its 2025 reopening under the Three Odd Guys Brewing team. Order: Rotating house craft beers.

places.ad: 337 N Shine Ave, Orlando, FL 32803
places.w: Voted Best Downtown Restaurant and Best Brunch in Orlando Weekly's Best of Orlando 2026 readers' poll, and a MICHELIN Guide-listed Colonialtown neighborhood bistro. Order: Fried green tomatoes with crab cakes.

places.ad: 1600 W Fairbanks Ave, Winter Park, FL 32789
places.w: John Rivers' original Winter Park smokehouse (opened 2009) won Best Barbecue in Orlando Weekly's Best of Orlando 2026 readers' poll. Order: 18-hour smoked Angus brisket.

places.ad: 802 Virginia Dr, Orlando, FL 32803
places.w: Voted Best Ivanhoe Village Restaurant in Orlando Weekly's Best of Orlando 2026 readers' poll; a long-running Spanish tapas bar reviewed (and revisited) by Scott Joseph. Order: Gambas al ajillo.

places.ad: 8625 International Dr, Orlando, FL 32819
places.w: Voted Best I-Drive Restaurant in Orlando Weekly's Best of Orlando 2026 readers' poll; a 30-plus-year artist-studio tapas house where resident painters work during service. Order: Spiced alligator bites with key lime mustard.

places.ad: 1140 E Altamonte Dr, Altamonte Springs, FL 32701
places.w: Voted Best Altamonte Springs Restaurant in Orlando Weekly's Best of Orlando 2026 readers' poll; Stefano LaCommare's family Sicilian seafood-and-pasta house (Scott Joseph review). Order: Gnocchi del Nonno.

places.ad: 108 S Park Ave, Winter Park, FL 32789
places.w: A finalist for Best Winter Park Restaurant in Orlando Weekly's Best of Orlando 2026 readers' poll; the Park Avenue original (2005) won a Foodie Award for Best Middle Eastern and is known for its giant puffed lavas. Order: Lavas (puffed baked-to-order bread).

places.ad: 549 W Par St, Orlando, FL 32804
places.w: Voted Best College Park Restaurant in Orlando Weekly's Best of Orlando 2026 readers' poll; the clubhouse grill at the historic Dubsdread golf course, famed for its half-pound burger (Tasty Chomps). Order: Tap Room classic cheeseburger.

places.ad: 1103 N Mills Ave, Orlando, FL 32803
places.w: The 2011 Mills 50 original of the Orlando-born Hawkers chain, on Orlando Weekly's '27 essential Mills 50 restaurants' list and praised by Andrew Zimmern; Tasty Chomps profiles its roti canai and laksa. Order: Roti canai with curry sauce.

places.ad: 710 N Mills Ave, Orlando, FL 32803
places.w: Taiwanese-style gua bao counter on Orlando Weekly's '27 essential Mills 50 restaurants' list, reviewed by Scott Joseph and Tasty Chomps. Order: Hogzilla pork-belly bao.

places.ad: 932 N Mills Ave, Orlando, FL 32803
places.w: Asian-Mexican fusion taco shop in Mills 50 since 2011, on Orlando Weekly's '27 essential Mills 50 restaurants' list and named a favorite by ClickOrlando. Order: Spicy-sweet Korean chicken taco.

places.ad: 640 S Orlando Ave, Maitland, FL 32751
places.w: MICHELIN Guide Florida 2026 Recommended (per Visit Orlando); James Beard-nominated chef Brandon McGlamery's open-fire American room and raw bar (Orlando Weekly profile). Order: Wood-fired prime rib.

places.ad: 3122 E Colonial Dr, Orlando, FL 32803
places.w: Listed in the MICHELIN Guide (Plate 2024 and 2025; Recommended in the 2026 Florida guide per Visit Orlando) for inventive pan-Asian-leaning sushi and omakase on East Colonial. Order: Torched salmon with truffle pâté (omakase).

places.ad: 252 N Park Ave, Winter Park, FL 32789
places.w: Runner-up for Best Brunch in Orlando Weekly's Best of Orlando 2026 readers' poll; a Park Avenue breakfast institution since 1980 (Winter Park Magazine, Tasty Chomps). Order: Raspberry-and-brie stuffed French toast.

places.ad: Rosen Shingle Creek resort, Orlando, FL
places.w: AAA Four Diamond steakhouse named for Patrick Smith's Florida-pioneer novel — reviewed by Scott Joseph, on @somehowimnotfat's must-try list (FOX 35). Order: Prime Black Angus from Harris Rosen's ranch.

places.ad: Dellagio Town Center, Dr. Phillips (Restaurant Row), Orlando, FL
places.w: James Beard-winning 'father of New World Cuisine' Norman Van Aken's flagship, reborn on Restaurant Row in 2023 — Orlando Weekly, Scott Joseph and @somehowimnotfat (FOX 35). Order: New World Cuisine (Latin-Caribbean-Asian fusion).

places.ad: 424 N Bumby Ave, Orlando, FL
places.w: Orlando institution serving roast-beef sandwiches since 1968 — News 6 covered its 50th anniversary; on Bungalower's and Orlando Weekly's 'eat like a local' lists. Order: Roast beef sandwich (sliced to order since 1968).

places.ad: 4721 E Colonial Dr, Orlando, FL
places.w: Family-owned east-Orlando steakhouse since 1947 — Scott Joseph review, Orlando Weekly's 'beefy Orlando restaurants' and Bungalower's must-try-as-a-local list. Order: Hand-cut steak with garlic bread.

places.ad: Four Seasons Resort Orlando at Walt Disney World Resort (17th-floor rooftop), Lake Buena Vista, FL
places.w: Spanish-accented rooftop steakhouse that held a Michelin star 2022-2025 and stays Michelin Recommended in 2026; star coverage in the West Orange Observer. Order: Hickory-grilled steaks and Basque tapas.

places.ad: 2840 Curry Ford Rd, Orlando, FL
places.w: Kevin & Maria Ruiz's modern Peruvian counter — Michelin star 2024 and 2025, then Recommended; Orlando Weekly reported its closing in September 2026. Kept, flagged closed. Order: Modern Peruvian family-style menu.

places.ad: 239 W 4th Ave, Mount Dora, FL
places.w: Lake Dora-view Florida scratch kitchen since 2003 — on Orlando Weekly's essential Mount Dora list and reviewed by Scott Joseph. Order: Caribbean crab cakes.

places.ad: 330 Dora Drawdy Way, Mount Dora, FL
places.w: Bookshelf-lined hideaway down an alley, open since 1996 — on Orlando Weekly's essential Mount Dora list and Life in Lake's restaurant guide. Order: Crab bisque with sherry.

places.ad: 2316 Black Hammock Fish Camp Rd, Oviedo, FL
places.w: Old-Florida fish camp on gator-thick Lake Jesup (airboats, live gator exhibit) — Tasty Chomps 2026 write-up and Orlando Weekly's small-town restaurants list. Order: Fried or blackened gator tail.

places.ad: 205 E 1st St, Sanford, FL
places.w: Family-run German beer hall (2001) that grew to 665 seats with a rooftop biergarten, credited with reviving downtown Sanford — Spectrum News 13, News 6 and Orlando Weekly. Order: Schnitzel and a boot of beer.

places.ad: 1236 Hempel Ave, Gotha, FL
places.w: CIA-trained Fish Morgan's sandwich house in the 1910 Brockman House — Orlando Weekly readers' Best Windermere restaurant; Scott Joseph review; 20th-anniversary coverage in the Observer. Order: 'White Trash' pulled-pork sandwich with pecan bacon.

places.ad: Historic Edgewater Hotel, downtown Winter Garden, FL
places.w: Prix-fixe room in the historic Edgewater Hotel opened 2008 by two ex-Disney chefs — runner-up Best Winter Garden restaurant in Orlando Weekly's readers' poll; reviewed by Scott Joseph. Order: Three-course prix-fixe with wine pairings.

places.ad: 1610 E. Buena Vista Drive, Lake Buena Vista, FL
places.w: Florida's only Master Sommelier-owned wine bar (George Miliotes); Food Network names it among Disney Springs' best and Time Out Orlando rates it 5/5. Order: Wines by the ounce from a 140+ pour list.

places.ad: Canada Pavilion, World Showcase, EPCOT, Bay Lake, FL
places.w: Won Readers' Choice for Best Theme Park Restaurant at the Orlando Sentinel 2025 Foodie Awards; among the top-rated EPCOT table services in TouringPlans reader surveys (87.5%). Order: Canadian Cheddar Cheese Soup and filet mignon.

places.ad: Italy Pavilion, World Showcase, EPCOT, Bay Lake, FL
places.w: Runner-up for Readers' Choice Best Theme Park Restaurant at the Orlando Sentinel 2025 Foodie Awards; Food Network lists it among EPCOT's best for its three wood-fired ovens. Order: Wood-fired Neapolitan pizza (Caputo flour).

places.ad: Japan Pavilion, World Showcase, EPCOT, Bay Lake, FL
places.w: Critics' Choice runner-up for Best Theme Park Restaurant at the Orlando Sentinel 2025 Foodie Awards; Food Network singles out its five element-themed dining rooms and Wagyu tasting menus. Order: Wagyu multi-course tasting menu.

places.ad: Morocco Pavilion, World Showcase, EPCOT, Bay Lake, FL
places.w: Critics' Choice runner-up for Best Theme Park Restaurant at the Orlando Sentinel 2025 Foodie Awards; on Food Network's best-of-EPCOT list for its lagoon-side tapas. Order: Mediterranean/North African small plates with sangria.

places.ad: 1620 E. Buena Vista Drive, Disney Springs, Lake Buena Vista, FL
places.w: 1st place, Best Theme Park Restaurant, Orlando Weekly Best of Orlando 2025 readers' poll; TouringPlans readers give it a 93% thumbs-up and it won Orlando Magazine Readers' Choice for Best Outdoor Dining and Best View. Order: Raw-bar oysters (plus the vintage Amphicar lake tour).

places.ad: 3628 W Vine St, Kissimmee, FL 34741
places.w: Family-run Puerto Rican kitchen (opened 2017) profiled by FOX 35 and WFTV as it grew to four Central Florida locations, and named in Orlando Weekly's Kissimmee hole-in-the-wall round-up for its mofongo and seafood. Order: Mofongo (El Mar Picao: mofongo with lobster tail and shrimp in lobster sauce).

places.ad: 131 Broadway, Kissimmee, FL 34741
places.w: Downtown Kissimmee Cuban cafe (opened 2013) named in Orlando Weekly's Kissimmee hole-in-the-wall round-up for its strong coladas and the Benny Cuban, and reviewed by Florida Cuban-food creator Burger Beast. Order: Benny Cuban sandwich with a colada.

places.ad: 1985 S John Young Pkwy, Kissimmee, FL 34741
places.w: Roast-pork counter whose owner Lisandra Roman pit-roasts lechón over charcoal for ~6 hours (Spectrum News 13 Hispanic Heritage feature); listed in Orlando Weekly's Kissimmee hole-in-the-wall round-up. Order: Lechón asado a la varita (charcoal pit-roasted whole pig).

places.ad: Lake Nona Wave Hotel, 6100 Wave Hotel Dr, Orlando, FL 32827
places.w: Upscale pan-American restaurant in the Lake Nona Wave Hotel listed in the MICHELIN Guide Orlando selection (recommended since 2022) and reviewed by Scott Joseph and Time Out. Order: Banana cream tart by World Pastry Cup-winning pastry chef Laurent Branlard.

places.ad: Lake Nona Wave Hotel, 6100 Wave Hotel Dr, Orlando, FL 32827
places.w: Contemporary Japanese restaurant with a 10-seat omakase counter in the Lake Nona Wave Hotel, added to the MICHELIN Guide Florida selection in 2025 and reviewed by Orlando Weekly. Order: Wagyu "beef and broccoli" (grilled wagyu, broccoli four ways).

places.ad: 649 Front St, Celebration, FL 34747
places.w: The Celebration branch (opened 1997) of Tampa's Ybor City Columbia, Florida's oldest restaurant (founded 1905), recommended by Frommer's Orlando guide for its Spanish-Cuban classics. Order: Original "1905" Salad and the Cuban sandwich.

places.ad: 3270 Margaritaville Blvd (Sunset Walk), Kissimmee, FL 34747
places.w: Voted Best BBQ Restaurant in Orlando Magazine's 2025 Orlando Dining Awards readers' choice; covered by Tasty Chomps and Experience Kissimmee. Order: Memphis-style baby back ribs.

places.ad: Sunset Walk at Margaritaville Resort Orlando, Margaritaville Blvd, Kissimmee, FL 34747
places.w: Gloria and Emilio Estefan's Cuban restaurant-and-salsa venue (opened 2020, Spectrum News 13) won first place for Best Latin in Orlando Magazine's 2025 Orlando Dining Awards readers' choice. Order: Lechón asado.

places.ad: 1912 Fortune Rd, Kissimmee, FL 34744
places.w: Family-run Puerto Rican bakery opened in 2008 that News 6 (ClickOrlando) calls a must-stop Kissimmee destination; owner honored by WFTV-covered Florida Puerto Rican Parade and named U.S. Senate Small Business of the Week. Order: Quesitos and pan sobao (plus mofongo and tripletas).

places.ad: 1475 Garden St, Titusville, FL
places.w: Titusville fish house (opened 1983) credited with turning the hard-shelled Cape Canaveral rock shrimp into a delicacy — Florida Rambler and Roadfood both profile it. Order: Broiled rock shrimp.

places.ad: 6485 S US Hwy 1, Rockledge, FL
places.w: Indian River Lagoon-front seafood room with The Dock patio — Space Coast Living readers' Best Seafood Restaurant 2025; reviewed by Scott Joseph. Order: Yellowtail snapper.

places.ad: 730 N Mills Ave, Orlando, FL 32803
places.w: Mills 50 pho institution; #2 Best Pho in Orlando Weekly's 2025 readers' poll and a Lonely Planet pick. Order: Pho, banh mi, rice-vermicelli bowls with grilled meats.

places.ad: 1110 E Colonial Dr, Orlando, FL 32803
places.w: Asian market + food hall built on the site of the 1986 Tien Hung Vietnamese market, now home to several Michelin-recognised stalls; a 2026 Time Out Orlando best-restaurant entry. Order: Bánh mì, onigiri and udon stalls (Bánh Mì Boy, UniGirl, Zaru…).

places.ad: The Landing, Disney Springs, 1640 E Buena Vista Dr, Lake Buena Vista, FL 32830
places.w: Ranked #1 table-service restaurant in TouringPlans 2023 Best of Disney World Dining awards (96.1%); Frommers-listed; live Irish bands & dancers nightly. Order: Fish and chips with live Irish music & dance.

places.ad: 16th floor (rooftop), Gran Destino Tower, Disney's Coronado Springs Resort, Lake Buena Vista, FL 32830
places.w: MICHELIN Guide-listed Spanish rooftop restaurant atop Gran Destino Tower with fireworks views; reviewed by Disney Food Blog and Laughing Place. Order: Tapas and House Boards (charcuterie & cheese) from the on-stage tapas kitchen.

places.ad: Jambo House, Disney's Animal Kingdom Lodge, Lake Buena Vista, FL 32830
places.w: Top-rated Disney resort table service (96.9% thumbs-up, TouringPlans); Disney Food Blog's best-splurge pick of the Animal Kingdom Lodge restaurants. Order: South African-inspired tasting of seafood, meats and handmade pasta.

places.ad: Universal CityWalk (second floor, next to Red Oven Pizza Bakery), Orlando, FL
places.w: Sushi-and-burger fusion counted among CityWalk's standouts by Fodor's and TouringPlans; Attractions Magazine covered its opening. Order: Burgushi (sushi-burger fusion rolls).

places.ad: 7048 International Dr, Orlando, FL
places.w: Family-run since 2006; Critic's Choice Best African in the 2023 Orlando Sentinel Foodie Awards (per Tasty Chomps), profiled by Orlando Magazine and reviewed by Scott Joseph. Order: Traditional coffee ceremony (pan-roasted beans brewed in a jebena).

places.ad: 8957 International Dr, Orlando, FL 32819
places.w: Chef Maneerat's woman-owned Thai kitchen (2021) on Tasty Chomps' best Thai restaurants in Orlando for 2025 and on food creator @somehowimnotfat's 24 must-try Orlando restaurants (FOX 35 / Visit Orlando). Order: Thai yellow curry and Pad Se-Ew.

places.ad: Pointe Orlando, 9101 International Dr, Orlando, FL
places.w: Tex-Mex/Mexican street-food spot from the Taverna Opa team, reviewed favorably by Orlando Weekly and Scott Joseph; on @somehowimnotfat's 24 must-try list (FOX 35). Order: Black bean & corn empanadas with 150+ tequilas.

places.ad: 11951 International Dr, Unit B2, Orlando, FL 32821
places.w: MICHELIN Guide-listed "2D noodle bar" from the Sticky Rice Lao Street Food team; raved by Orlando Weekly, Tasty Chomps and The Infatuation. Order: Signature bone-in short rib pho.

places.ad: 8548 Palm Pkwy, Orlando, FL
places.w: Chef Lewis Lin's retro, manga-styled izakaya whose yakitori Orlando Weekly compared to NYC's Michelin-starred Torishin; also covered by Tasty Chomps and reviewed by The Infatuation. Order: Yakitori chicken thigh & 24-hour tori paitan ramen.

places.ad: 8081 Turkey Lake Rd, Orlando, FL 32819
places.w: MICHELIN Guide-recommended Cantonese restaurant (Dr. Phillips) noted by the Guide for its comprehensive made-to-order dim sum; Visit Orlando lists it among Orlando's MICHELIN Recommended. Order: Made-to-order dim sum — siu mai, egg tarts, pineapple pork buns.

places.ad: Jambo House, Disney's Animal Kingdom Lodge, Lake Buena Vista, FL 32830
places.w: Pan-African buffet listed by Frommer's and Fodor's; Disney Food Blog (Jan 2026) calls its breakfast still one of the best in Disney World. Order: Turkey bobotie, peri peri chicken and zebra domes (Amarula mousse) on the African buffet.

places.ad: 448 N Terry Ave, Orlando, FL 32801
places.w: Creative Village comfort-food restaurant named for Wells'Built founder Dr. William Monroe Wells; Orlando Weekly named it a best opening of 2021 and voted it #3 Best Downtown Restaurant in Best of Orlando 2025, and The Infatuation recommends its fried chicken.

places.ad: 1830 E Colonial Dr, Ste B, Orlando, FL 32803
places.w: Mills 50 Vietnamese-Asian kitchen holding a MICHELIN Bib Gourmand since 2022 (ClickOrlando Bib Gourmand round-up). Order: Vietnamese-Asian small plates (pho, rice bowls).

places.ad: 400 S Orlando Ave, Maitland, FL 32751
places.w: Sicilian-run Italian restaurant voted Best Restaurant Overall and Best Maitland Restaurant in Orlando Weekly's Best of Orlando 2025; reviewed favourably by the Orange Observer and Scott Joseph. Order: Sicilian-style pasta and pizza.

places.ad: 2120 Edgewater Dr, Orlando, FL 32804
places.w: College Park handmade-pasta restaurant profiled by Tasty Chomps and Scott Joseph, and voted #3 Best College Park Restaurant in Orlando Weekly's Best of Orlando 2025. Order: Handmade pasta; prosciutto & burrata bruschetta.

places.ad: 728 N Thornton Ave, Orlando, FL 32803
places.w: Eight-person standing hand-roll sushi bar in Mills 50, in the MICHELIN Guide (Recommended) since 2023 and listed by Time Out Orlando. Order: Hand rolls (temaki) at the standing bar.

places.ad: 1915 E Colonial Dr, Orlando, FL 32803
places.w: Orlando's only MICHELIN-recognized Lao restaurant (Recommended), on East Colonial in Mills 50; reviewed by Scott Joseph. Order: Pork laab with purple sticky rice.

places.ad: 720 N Mills Ave, Orlando, FL 32803
places.w: Mills 50 izakaya from Sean 'Sonny' Nguyen serving yakitori, bar bites and sake; MICHELIN Recommended.

places.ad: 17 W Church St, Orlando, FL 32801
places.w: Downtown chophouse in a 1930s Church Street landmark, reviewed by Orlando Weekly and Scott Joseph and voted #2 Best Downtown Restaurant in Orlando Weekly's Best of Orlando 2025. Order: House-aged prime steak.

places.ad: 1212 Woodward St, Orlando, FL 32803
places.w: Long-running Mills 50 dim sum house a block north of Colonial & Mills, on Orlando Weekly's essential Mills 50 list and repeatedly reviewed by Tasty Chomps as one of Orlando's best dim sum spots. Order: Weekend cart dim sum (turnip dumplings, fried shrimp cakes).

places.ad: 1323 N Mills Ave, Orlando, FL 32803
places.w: Farm-to-taco Mills 50 taqueria (2016) reviewed by Orlando Weekly, Scott Joseph and Tasty Chomps; reported as a three-time Orlando Sentinel Foodie Awards Best Tacos winner and in the MICHELIN Guide since 2022. Order: Achiote pork taco.

places.ad: 100 S Eola Dr, Orlando, FL 32801
places.w: Durable Thornton Park New American restaurant in the Sanctuary building, reviewed by Scott Joseph and voted #2 Best Thornton Park/South Eola Restaurant in Orlando Weekly's Best of Orlando 2025. Order: Moscow Mule in a copper cup.

places.ad: 113 S Palmetto Ave, Sanford, FL 32771
places.w: Housed in the 1914-1959 Seminole County Jail; voted Best Restaurant Overall and Best New Restaurant in Scott Joseph's 2019 Foodster Awards, reviewed by Tasty Chomps and listed by AAA; opening an MCO airport outpost in 2025. Order: Chicken Pot Pie Gnocchi.

places.ad: 320 Dora Drawdy Way, Mount Dora, FL 32757
places.w: Named in Orlando Weekly's essential Mount Dora restaurants ("arguably the best mojito in Central Florida", seafood paella its most popular dish), listed in Life in Lake's Mount Dora guide and profiled by the Triangle Sun. Order: Seafood paella and mojitos.

places.ad: 115 W 3rd Ave, Mount Dora, FL 32757
places.w: Mediterranean-Italian downtown spot named in Orlando Weekly's essential Mount Dora restaurants for its pastas and baklava, and in Life in Lake's Mount Dora restaurant guide. Order: Baklava and house pastas.

places.ad: 146 W Plant St, Winter Garden, FL 34787
places.w: Chef-owner Ryan Freelove's seasonal contemporary-American restaurant on historic Plant Street (rooftop aquaponic garden), named in Orlando Weekly's essential Winter Garden restaurants, reviewed by Scott Joseph and listed by Visit Orlando. Order: Seasonal tasting plates finished with "The Cloud" house-made cotton candy.

places.ad: 422 S Alafaya Trl, Orlando, FL 32828
places.w: Waterford Lakes Puerto Rican restaurant named for the island's pork highway; Orlando Sentinel Foodie Awards Best Puerto Rican (2010) per Tasty Chomps, reviewed by Orlando Weekly ("Rico Mountain High") and still listed in Orlando Weekly's current East Orlando picks. Order: Pernil with arroz con gandules and pastelillos.

places.ad: 2039 N Atlantic Ave, Cocoa Beach, FL 32931
places.w: Husband-and-wife locally-sourced seafood house named Best Seafood Restaurant in Space Coast Living's Best of the Space Coast readers' awards and listed by Frommer's Cocoa Beach guide. Order: Crab bisque and sea-to-table grilled local fish.

places.ad: 500 Glen Cheek Dr, Cape Canaveral, FL 32920
places.w: Port Canaveral waterfront seafood deck (since 1997, founded by commercial fishermen) picked by News 6 ClickOrlando among Space Coast breakfast spots with launch views; Space Coast Living reviewed its Melbourne spin-off as "a taste of Port Canaveral". Order: Fresh-catch fish tacos and poke on the deck at a rocket launch.

places.ad: 125 W 1st St, Sanford, FL 32771
places.w: Memphis-born chef Nat Russell's breakfast-and-lunch spot named in Orlando Weekly's 20 essential Sanford restaurants, reviewed by Tasty Chomps, and twice Best Chef in My Sanford Magazine's Best of Sanford awards. Order: Southern breakfast plates with house pickled ramps.

places.ad: 214 E 1st St, Sanford, FL 32771
places.w: Sanford gourmet-marshmallow maker whose downtown shop (store-only flavors, ice cream, workshops) is in Orlando Weekly's essential Sanford restaurants and featured on FOX 35. Order: Gourmet marshmallow s'mores and marshmallow-topped Lineage coffee.

places.ad: 316 Brevard Ave, Cocoa, FL 32922
places.w: Historic Cocoa Village coffeehouse-turned-French bakery (since 2003) next to the Cocoa Village Playhouse, profiled by Space Coast Living and included on TravelMole's Space Coast ice cream tour for its rotating homemade ice creams. Order: French pastries with house-made ice cream.

places.ad: United Kingdom Pavilion, World Showcase, EPCOT, 200 Epcot Center Dr, Lake Buena Vista, FL
places.w: Disney Food Blog's eaten-everywhere EPCOT ranking praises its beer-battered hake fish and chips; TouringPlans reports a 95% guest rating for the Rose & Crown pub and fish shop.

places.n: Regal Eagle Smokehouse: Craft Drafts & Barbecue
places.ad: The American Adventure Pavilion, World Showcase, EPCOT, 200 Epcot Center Dr, Lake Buena Vista, FL
places.w: Disney Food Blog's review says it 'went from awful to awesome' and ranks it among EPCOT's best; Theme Park Insider and WDWNT both reviewed its Muppets-themed barbecue. Order: Memphis dry-rub ribs and Texas brisket.

places.ad: Toy Story Land, Disney's Hollywood Studios, 351 S Studio Dr, Lake Buena Vista, FL
places.w: Disney Food Blog's favorite-snacks review names its homemade Lunch Box Tart an iconic Hollywood Studios snack; The Infatuation's Hollywood Studios guide points to it in Toy Story Land. Order: Raspberry Lunch Box Tart and Totchos.

places.ad: Germany Pavilion, World Showcase, EPCOT, 200 Epcot Center Dr, Lake Buena Vista, FL
places.w: TouringPlans' review calls it a brilliant value in today's EPCOT; Disney Food Blog's eaten-everywhere ranking praises its buffet quality and live German entertainment. Order: Bratwurst-and-spaetzle buffet with an oompah band.

places.ad: The Land Pavilion, EPCOT, 200 Epcot Center Dr, Lake Buena Vista, FL
places.w: TouringPlans rates the revolving character meal 95% ('Exceptional'), ranked #6 of 92 Disney World table services; Disney Food Blog features it in its EPCOT character-dining guide. Order: Family-style platters with produce grown in The Land pavilion.

places.ad: Cinderella Castle, Fantasyland, Magic Kingdom, 1180 Seven Seas Dr, Lake Buena Vista, FL
places.w: The only restaurant inside Cinderella Castle; Disney Food Blog, TouringPlans and Disney Tourist Blog all review it, rating the food above average but the setting the draw. Order: Prix-fixe princess feast in the castle's Grand Dining Hall.

places.ad: 8031 Turkey Lake Rd #700, Orlando, FL 32819
places.w: Orlando Weekly readers voted it Best Sand Lake/Dr. Phillips Restaurant in Best of Orlando 2025; a 20+-year Restaurant Row sushi standby featured by Visit Orlando's Restaurant Row guide (chef-partner Huy Tin). Order: Omakase sushi & signature rolls.

places.ad: 7600 Dr Phillips Blvd, Orlando, FL 32819
places.w: Restaurant Row's grande-dame Italian since 1984 — Tasty Chomps' 35th-anniversary profile recounts Bob Hope joking about its enormous veal chops on The Tonight Show, strolling musicians and a Wine Spectator award; Disney Tourist Blog lists it as its fine-dining pick near Disney World. Order: Veal chop (the one Bob Hope joked about on Carson).

places.ad: 7533 W Sand Lake Rd, Orlando, FL
places.w: Named in Orlando Weekly's '30 best restaurants a short drive from Orlando theme parks' for its award-winning wine bar, live music, prime steaks and fresh-caught seafood; a Visit Orlando Restaurant Row feature. Order: Prime steaks & fresh-caught seafood with live music.

places.ad: 2901 Parkway Blvd Suite 1A, Kissimmee, FL 34747
places.w: Orlando Weekly readers placed Charley's 2nd for Best Kissimmee Restaurant (and 2nd for Best I-Drive) in Best of Orlando 2025; Tasty Chomps lists it among Orlando restaurants honored in Wine Spectator's 2025 Restaurant Awards (Best of Award of Excellence). Family-owned Central Florida steakhouse since 1974. Order: Aged USDA Prime steak flame-grilled over citrus & oak wood.

places.ad: 324 Broadway, Kissimmee, FL
places.w: Downtown Kissimmee's wood-smoked BBQ joint (since 2015) opposite Lakefront Park, with weekend live rock/blues on the porch — on Orlando Weekly's '20 Kissimmee hole-in-the-wall restaurants worth the drive' and Experience Kissimmee's downtown live-entertainment picks. Order: Brisket biscuit & slow-smoked Super Sampler.

places.ad: Pointe Orlando, 9101 International Dr #2240, Orlando, FL 32819
places.w: I-Drive's raucous Greek taverna — table-top belly dancing, flying napkins and saganaki flamed tableside (Orlando Weekly's '30 best restaurants a short drive from Orlando theme parks'; long-running Tasty Chomps coverage, 2012–2021). Order: Flaming saganaki & wood-fired lamb chops.

places.ad: 11701 International Dr, 300, Orlando, FL 32821
places.w: Cantonese BBQ and dim sum run by Jerry & Jackie Lau (of Michelin-listed Kai Kai) for the Twenty Pho Hour team — Orlando Weekly's review calls Jerry Lau 'a stir fry master' with real wok hei and singles out the siu mai; in Tasty Chomps' 2026 AAPI dining guide. Order: Roast duck, char siu & siu mai dim sum.

places.ad: 7563 W Sand Lake Rd, Orlando, FL
places.w: Orlando Weekly readers voted it Best Sand Lake or Dr. Phillips Bar in Best of Orlando 2025 (over Domu and Sixty Vines); Tasty Chomps' 2025 Happy Hour Hit List highlights its 1,000+ whiskies, burgers and Southern comfort food. Order: Whiskey-forward craft cocktails & fresh-ground gourmet burgers.

places.ad: Downtown Celebration lakefront, Celebration (Kissimmee), FL 34747
places.w: Boston-owned New England seafood tavern on Celebration's lakefront that flies in its clams — profiled by Spectrum News 13's 'Insider' (2019); Disney Tourist Blog calls it the locals' hangout 'straight out of Cheers'. Order: Ipswich fried clams & 'wicked good' clam chowder.

places.ad: 295 NE Ivanhoe Blvd, Orlando, FL 32804
places.w: MICHELIN Bib Gourmand (Florida guide): lakeside dining room over Lake Ivanhoe named for Orlando's pineapple-growing past; Michelin singles out the smoked peanut soup and pimento-cheese bread board. Visit Orlando Michelin roundup also lists it in Ivanhoe Village. Order: Smoked peanut soup; bread board with pimento cheese.

places.ad: 1110 E Colonial Dr (inside Mills Market), Orlando, FL 32803
places.w: MICHELIN Recommended 2025 and 2026: NYC-Chinatown-style Cantonese barbecue and handmade dumplings from a husband-and-wife team inside Mills Market; Tasty Chomps (Aug 2026) reports it expanding to Minneola. News 6 covered its Michelin entry. Order: Char siu, crispy pork, roast duck bao, handmade dumplings.

places.ad: 3201 Corrine Dr (inside East End Market), Orlando, FL 32803
places.w: MICHELIN Recommended (2025 new addition): Chef Sonny Nguyen's gyukatsu counter in East End Market, Audubon Park — diners sear their breaded beef cutlet on a hot stone. Tasty Chomps and Orlando Weekly covered its 2025 opening. Order: Gyukatsu (beef cutlet) finished on a tabletop hot stone.

places.ad: 30 S Magnolia Ave (Phoenix Building), Orlando, FL 32801
places.w: Orlando Weekly readers' Best Downtown Bar 2023, 2024 and 2025, and Orlando Magazine 2025 Dining Awards Best Cocktails: a 1920s-styled speakeasy in a historic downtown building known for its Bathtub Gin cocktails, dueling pianos and burlesque nights.

places.ad: 2816 Corrine Dr, Orlando, FL 32803
places.w: Orlando Magazine 2025 Dining Awards Best Restaurant (readers' choice): Chef Bruno Fonseca's intimate ~10-seat Audubon Park counter serving a trust-the-chef tasting built on local produce and fermentation. Orlando Weekly has covered it since opening, including a Jaleo collab dinner. Order: Menu Confiance — weekly-changing 10-course chef's tasting (Brazilian/Portuguese/Italian/Spanish influences).

places.ad: 1234 N Orange Ave, Winter Park, FL 32789
places.w: Orlando Magazine 2025 Dining Awards Best Restaurant (readers' choice finalist alongside Foreigner and Camille): a Southern coastal fish-camp concept with a daily blackboard of Florida catches. Listed by Visit Orlando; reviewed by Scott Joseph. Order: Shrimp & cheese grits; whole fried market fish; hogfish and tilefish specials.

places.ad: 742 Carter St, Orlando, FL 32805
places.w: Parramore's living landmark: opened 1949 as Roser's Restaurant, it fed chitlin'-circuit musicians, athletes and civil-rights leaders; renamed Nikki's Place in 1999 and reopened in 2017 after a 2015 fire with city grants. Orlando Weekly calls it one of Orlando's most distinctive meat-and-threes; Scott Joseph reviewed it on WMFE. Order: Meat-and-three: oxtails, chitterlings, fried pork chops, catfish.

places.ad: 501 N Orlando Ave, Maitland, FL 32751
places.w: Family-run Maitland sub shop since 1967; nearly closed for good in Sept 2024 (News 6 covered its 'last day') before reopening weeks later (FOX 35), and Orlando Weekly readers voted it the 2025 runner-up Best Maitland Restaurant. Floridiana Magazine's 'Florida Eats' profiled its cheesesteak. Order: Cheesesteak sub with sweet potato fries.

places.ad: 1021 S. Dillard St., Winter Garden, FL
places.w: Orlando Weekly review: fuses flamboyance with flavor and straight fire — "the chicken 65... is the best $9 you'll spend on chicken anywhere"; from the owners of Cilantro Indian Cuisine (Orange Observer).

places.ad: 139 N Central Ave, Oviedo, FL
places.w: Family-run Oviedo diner serving since the 1950s with an award-winning breakfast; on Orlando Weekly's list of classic Orlando-area restaurants open 25+ years; a local landmark. Order: Biscuits and gravy; blueberry pancakes (breakfast all day).

places.ad: 5240 N Atlantic Ave, Unit 100, Cocoa Beach, FL
places.w: Quinisha Bredwood's 'soulful seafood' kitchen (opened July 2020) — Space Coast Living's Best New Restaurant, a News 6 (WKMG) feature, and Chowhound's pick for giant butter-drenched Florida seafood platters. Order: Snow-crab clusters in garlic butter & Cajun seasoning; shrimp and grits.

places.ad: 5494 Central Florida Pkwy, Orlando, FL 32821
places.w: MICHELIN Guide Florida 2026 Recommended (SeaWorld area) — Orlando's Michelin-listed Ethiopian/Eritrean kitchen: injera with doro wat, tibs and shiro. Order: injera platters (doro wat, tibs, shiro).

places.ad: 1555 FL-436 #1171, Winter Park, FL 32792
places.w: MICHELIN Guide Florida 2026 Recommended (Winter Park) — Asian street-food counter of bao, noodles and wings in a SR-436 strip. Order: Asian street-fare plates (bao, noodles, wings).

places.ad: 101 S Eola Dr Suite 103, Orlando, FL 32801
places.w: Thornton Park's polished-casual New American restaurant & wine bar (since 2012, repeat Wine Spectator Award of Excellence); moved from College Park to Thornton Park in 2021 (News 6); Visit Orlando listing. Order: new American plates with a Wine Spectator-awarded list.

places.ad: 5295 W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy, Kissimmee, FL 34746
places.w: Locally owned Dominican restaurant on US-192 — a stop on Gastro Obscura × Experience Kissimmee's 20-stop Latin Culinary Trail (2025): mangú, chicharrón, sancocho. Order: Dominican classics (mangú, chicharrón, sancocho).

places.ad: 1600 Osceola Pkwy, Kissimmee, FL 34744
places.w: Caribbean/Latin American fusion kitchen on Osceola Parkway — Gastro Obscura place page + Experience Kissimmee Latin Culinary Trail stop (2025). Order: Caribbean/Latin fusion plates.

places.ad: 5820 W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy, Kissimmee, FL 34746
places.w: Latin-fusion bistro on US-192 — Gastro Obscura place page + Experience Kissimmee Latin Culinary Trail stop (2025). Order: Latin-fusion bistro plates & cafecito.

places.ad: 801 E Washington St, Orlando, FL 32801
places.w: Thornton Park's 80-plus-year neighbourhood bar — one of downtown's longest-lived establishments, reopened under the same name in 2017 by The Lodge/The Woods owners; Orlando Weekly: the area's 'cheapest and friendliest' with a prime people-watching patio. Order: neighbourhood-bar burgers and cheap drinks on the patio.

places.ad: 4040 Central Florida Pkwy, Orlando, FL 32837
places.w: Two-time James Beard winner Melissa Kelly's farm-to-table Italian in the JW Marriott Grande Lakes (since 2003, redesigned 2021) — MICHELIN Guide Florida listed since the 2022 inaugural edition; produce, honey and eggs from its own garden. Order: seasonal Italian from the on-site Primo Garden.

places.ad: 7575 Dr Phillips Blvd, Orlando, FL 32819
places.w: Dr. Phillips fine-dining fixture for 30+ years — chef Tony Lopez's locally sourced menu; Orlando Weekly essential Dr. Phillips pick, reviewed and Magical Dining-featured by Scott Joseph. Order: chef Tony Lopez's seasonal fine dining (grouper with pecan butter).

places.ad: 7732 W Sand Lake Rd, Orlando, FL 32819
places.w: Restaurant Row's upscale Lebanese dining room — baked kibbeh and mezze; Orlando Weekly's Dr. Phillips guide, Scott Joseph listing. Order: baked kibbeh, mezze.

places.ad: 7972 Via Dellagio Way, Orlando, FL 32819
places.w: Dellagio's Japanese robata grill and sushi bar (from Gainesville) — five-time Florida Trend Golden Spoon winner (2015-19); reviewed by Orlando Weekly ('Mister Robata') and Scott Joseph. Order: robatayaki skewers and sushi.

places.ad: 1035 N Orlando Ave #105, Winter Park, FL 32789
places.w: MICHELIN Guide Florida Recommended (2024-26) — Winter Park's polished Sichuan dining room with a large family-style menu of layered, bold classics; Tasty Chomps inside look. Order: family-style Sichuan classics (mapo tofu, dry-fried dishes).

places.ad: 761 N Orange Ave, Winter Park, FL 32789
places.w: Former Orlando Weekly Best Seafood Restaurant winner — dockside-casual counter with a fresh-fish case (Orlando Weekly essential Winter Park; Scott Joseph review). Order: smoked fish dip, fish & chips, shrimp 'n' grits.

places.ad: 110 S Orlando Ave, Winter Park, FL 32789
places.w: Winter Park's Spanish tapas bar — chef Diego Solano's Barcelona-style small plates and cocktails (Orlando Weekly essential Winter Park; Winter Park Magazine 'Bite of Barcelona'). Order: tapas (croquetas, paella) by chef Diego Solano.

places.ad: 525 S Park Ave, Winter Park, FL 32789
places.w: Park Avenue sushi and robata bar — Orlando Weekly: 'stellar sashimi and robata offerings'; Scott Joseph review; Visit Orlando listing. Order: sashimi, robata skewers, Japanese-fusion small plates.

places.ad: 500 E Osceola Pkwy, Kissimmee, FL 34744
places.w: Dominican-Japanese sushi hideaway — Gastro Obscura video feature and stop on the Experience Kissimmee × Atlas Obscura Latin Culinary Trail. Order: Dominican-remix sushi rolls.

places.ad: 2381 N Orange Blossom Trl, Kissimmee, FL 34744
places.w: Venezuelan kitchen on the Gastro Obscura × Experience Kissimmee Latin Culinary Trail. Order: Venezuelan arepas and patacones from Paraguaná.

places.ad: 2160 W Columbia Ave, Kissimmee, FL 34741
places.w: Mexican stop on the Gastro Obscura × Experience Kissimmee Latin Culinary Trail. Order: Mexican tacos and antojitos.

places.ad: 3260 Vineland Rd Ste 100, Kissimmee, FL 34746
places.w: Venezuelan grill on the Gastro Obscura × Experience Kissimmee Latin Culinary Trail. Order: Venezuelan llanero grill plates.

places.ad: 610 Glen Cheek Dr, Cape Canaveral, FL 32920
places.w: Port Canaveral channel-side seafood house — the Port's webcam spot for watching cruise sail-aways and rocket launches from its tiki sun deck (FOX 35 'Beach Bites'; AAA). Order: fresh seafood on the upper deck as cruise ships sail out.

places.ad: 103 W Indiana Ave, DeLand, FL 32720
places.w: Historic downtown DeLand's destination restaurant built by multi-time James Beard nominee Hari Pulapaka (now chef-owner Tom Brandt) — 2025 DiRōNA Award, 2025 Wine Spectator Award of Excellence (Scott Joseph; DiRōNA). Order: globally inspired, locally sourced tasting-style plates.

places.ad: 1829 N Orange Ave, Orlando, FL 32804
places.w: Ivanhoe Village's 30-plus-year 'Orlando Classic' (Scott Joseph) — an antique shop turned cafe-bar, named for the owners' white shepherd; Orlando Weekly readers' #2 Ivanhoe Village restaurant 2025; Food Network's $40 a Day stop; Tasty Chomps snapshots. Order: giant cinnamon rolls, weekend brunch among antiques.

places.ad: 1308 Edgewater Dr, Orlando, FL 32804
places.w: College Park's breakfast-and-lunch diner (since the 1990s) named for its salt-and-pepper-shaker collection — Scott Joseph 'bona fide Orlando Classic' and Foodster Best Breakfast 2017; Orlando Weekly Edgewater essential + Best of Orlando 2026 entry. Order: breakfast plates and daily quiche under a wall of salt-and-pepper shakers.

places.ad: 3006 Edgewater Dr, Orlando, FL 32804
places.w: Paul Gabriel's family-run College Park sub shop (1958) — one of Orlando's oldest restaurants, still with its original milkshake machine and dining furniture (News 6 'last remaining iconic restaurants of Orlando' 2023; Orlando Weekly Edgewater essential). Order: cooked-to-order subs and shakes from the original milkshake machine.

places.ad: 7512 Dr Phillips Blvd #80, Orlando, FL 32819
places.w: Dr. Phillips' Mediterranean-leaning modern steakhouse — Orlando Weekly readers' Best Sand Lake/Dr. Phillips Restaurant 2026 (ahead of DOMU and Seito); its group took over Restaurant Row's Vines Grille as Vines by H in 2025 (Central Florida Lifestyle). Order: Mediterranean-inspired prime cuts and seafood.
